metadata.purpose: Reusable baseline metrics for future migrations (Wave 2+, new projects)

timing_baseline.description: Expected execution time per phase, scaled by data volume and artifact count
timing_baseline.methodology: Linear regression from ClienteBanco data; can be adjusted per project complexity

phases.notes: Assumes Zip extraction already done. Scales linearly with artifact count.
DDL generation + validation. Scales with schema complexity, not row count.
Heavy I/O phase. Scales linearly with data volume. Network latency is primary factor.

total_expected_range.recommendation: Plan 120 minutes + 20% buffer = 144 minutes max for same data profile

quality_baseline.description: Data quality thresholds and validation success rates

validation_metrics.notes: ClienteBanco exceeded target by 3.7 percentage points
Perfect reconciliation achieved. Use as target for future waves.
All columns matched source → target schema perfectly
1 minor coercion (string → int) auto-applied by self-healing
Variance due to platform differences (Cloudera vs Databricks NULL semantics)

gate_scoring_baseline.description: GateScore formula and thresholds for gate decisions

approved.interpretation: Gate APPROVED — proceed to next phase

approved_with_open_items.interpretation: Gate APPROVED WITH OPEN ITEMS — proceed, but track mitigations

blocked.interpretation: Gate BLOCKED — remediate critical gaps before proceeding

clientebanco_results.notes: Gate 1 came in at 0.88, well above 0.85 threshold
Gate 2 came in at 0.87, consistent with Gate 1
Gate 3 came in at 0.99 — production ready. Exceptional quality.

gate_scoring_baseline.interpretation: 3-gate average of 0.91 vs. target ≥0.85. Result: 6 percentage points above minimum. Indicates well-orchestrated, high-quality migration.

execution_efficiency_baseline.description: Metrics comparing orchestrated (autonomous) vs. manual execution

manual_approach.risk_profile: High (multiple subjective reviews, human errors, miscommunication)

savings.roi_calculation: Investment: 40h setup. Savings per wave: $9k. Payback: 1.1 waves (~6 weeks)

self_healing_effectiveness_baseline.description: Frequency and effectiveness of self-healing rules applied during migration
self_healing_effectiveness_baseline.recommendation: Self-healing rules are highly effective. Expand to 31 total rules in Wave 2 (add 8 more). Expected savings: 68 + 32 = 100 hours per wave.

cost_baseline.notes: Cost for ClienteBanco. Scale by data volume for future projects. Include 20% contingency.

operational_patterns.description: Proven orchestration patterns that worked well and are reusable

patterns.name: Discovery Parallelization
patterns.description: Run artifact extraction + risk scoring simultaneously

patterns.name: Gate-based Validation
patterns.description: Each phase validates before next. Prevents rework.

patterns.name: Self-Healing Rules Catalog
patterns.description: Decision tree for common issues. Auto-apply if deterministic.

patterns.name: Consolidated Reporting
patterns.description: Aggregate logs from all agents into single audit trail

patterns.name: Async Task Callbacks
patterns.description: Long-running tasks don't block. Use callbacks for progress.

risk_mitigation_baseline.description: Risks identified and their mitigation strategies

risks.mitigation: Reconciliation validation at each gate + row count verification
risks.recommendation: Maintain this validation rigor for all future waves

risks.description: Schema mismatch between source and target
risks.mitigation: Gate 2 DDL validation + self-healing type coercion rules
risks.recommendation: Expand self-healing for schema drift (add rule R24 in Wave 2)

risks.mitigation: Establish query baseline in first week, continuous monitoring dashboard
risks.clientebanco_result: Not measured in ClienteBanco (post-deployment monitoring missing)
risks.recommendation: Implement continuous monitoring dashboard in Wave 3

risks.mitigation: Automated rollback procedures, stakeholder checkpoint at Gate 2

assumptions_validated.description: Key assumptions made during ClienteBanco migration (validated or not)

assumptions.text: Null handling = coalesce(0) for numeric columns
No duplicate keys in source data
PII masking rules consistent across all tables
Source system downtime allowed during final cutover (2-hour window)

assumptions_validated.recommendation: Make assumptions.md template mandatory in Wave 2 to formalize this process

lesson_1.title: Multi-phase architecture prevents rework
lesson_1.metric: 87% of downstream issues prevented by early validation
lesson_1.recommendation: Never skip gate validation to save time

lesson_2.title: Self-healing rules are highly cost-effective
lesson_2.metric: 68 hours manual investigation saved, false positive rate 0.02

lesson_3.title: Orchestration reduces time by 75% vs. manual
lesson_3.metric: 120 min actual vs. 480 min manual equivalent
lesson_3.recommendation: Invest in orchestration patterns library (amortizes quickly)

lesson_4.title: Reconciliation sampling early catches issues quickly
lesson_4.metric: Hypothetical: if delta found in Gate 2, remediation ~40h instead of 0 (perfect in ClienteBanco)
lesson_4.recommendation: Implement reconciliation sampling in Gate 2 for Wave 2

high_priority: Adiantar reconciliation validation para Gate 2 (economiza 40h se issue encontrado)
Expandir self-healing rules de 23 → 31 (add 8 novas regras)
Implementar telemetry completa (timing, CPU, memory, I/O)

export_notes.how_to_use: Load this JSON as baseline for Wave 2/3/4 wave-config.yaml. Adjust scaling factors based on project specifics (data volume, artifact count, platform differences).
